lines.text: During a three-year famine, the LORD told David it was because Saul had killed the Gibeonites.
The Gibeonites refused silver and gold and asked David to give them seven of Saul's male descendants to hang at Gibeah.
David spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan because of his oath, and he delivered seven others to the Gibeonites at the start of the wheat harvest.
Rizpah kept the birds and beasts off the bodies, and David then took the bones of Saul and Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead.
The bones of Saul and Jonathan were buried in Zela in the tomb of Saul's father Jesse, and then God answered prayers for the land.
